decisions.reason: As a flagship service close to the firm’s core vessel-management capabilities in a growing and expanding business, it fits strongly with existing knowledge and is likely to be retained.
This service extends established crew and corporate support activities, so the firm can absorb feedback and improve it using capabilities it already has.
Although more digital in form, the portal builds on existing vessel-information and client-service knowledge and was presented as a focus area, which lowers the likelihood of withdrawal.

The app is still related to the core offer, but its mobile digital nature is somewhat farther from the firm’s traditional service base and likely harder to develop without strong in-house R&D, making it the most at risk among the four.
